# Kautusang Bayan Blg. 09, Serye 2022 -- Bangus Fish Cage Zone

## Summary

Establishes a designated zone for bangus (milkfish) fish cage aquaculture in the municipal waters of [[Pitogo]]. The ordinance promotes aquaculture development and sustainable use of the municipality's marine resources by creating a clearly defined area for bangus fish cage operations. Enacted under the general welfare powers of [[Sec-16-RA7160]].

## Key Provisions

- Establishes and delineates the "Bangus Fish Cage Zone" within [[Pitogo]]'s municipal waters
- Defines the boundaries and permitted uses of the designated aquaculture zone
- Sets regulations for fish cage installation and operation
- Establishes permit requirements for fish cage operators
- Provides guidelines for sustainable aquaculture practices
- Defines penalties for violations of zoning and operational regulations
- Promotes bangus (milkfish) aquaculture as a livelihood and economic activity
